label_semantics.MUST_INFLUENCE: For the named target role and frozen build profile, every realization of that target consumes the entity through a value, control, identity, or scope dependency. This does not mean every mutation flips the AP.
label_semantics.MAY_INFLUENCE: A feasible conditional or alternate definition/path can affect the target, but it is not consumed on every target realization.
label_semantics.MODEL_REQUIRED: The relationship crosses an external, scheduler, queue-lifecycle, callback, or synthetic-time boundary that ordinary intra-run def-use/control flow cannot establish alone.
label_semantics.SCOPE_ONLY: The entity selects the correlated exchange or generation but does not by itself determine the AP Boolean value once that scope is fixed.
label_semantics.CANDIDATE_NO_INFLUENCE: No path was found in the audited target semantics; this is a review candidate, not an arbitrated negative label.

must_influencers.justification: The post-send queue path is skipped unless the outbound PDU is Confirmable.
Reliable transports return before retransmission-node allocation; the accepted AP is the UDP/DTLS-style message-layer wait.
Delayed and failed writes return before a retransmission node is created; only a completed nonnegative write can realize the trigger.
A failed node allocation takes the error exit and cannot commit the queue generation.
The session ACK timeout is read by the exact fixed-point expression whose return value is stored in node->timeout.
The randomized upper factor is read on every coap_calc_timeout execution, even when a particular PRNG value makes its numeric contribution zero.
The PRNG byte is passed into and consumed by the initial timeout computation.
The final fixed-point result is scaled into the frozen platform's tick domain.
The initial generation is zero-initialized, and the stored delta shifts timeout by retransmit_cnt. This distinguishes the initial deadline from later retransmissions.
The trigger's exchange identity commits the outbound Message ID into the queue-node generation.

Every committed node is normalized against the current monotonic time and delta-queue base before insertion. Existing queue state changes representation but not the intended logical now+initial-delay deadline.
The frozen implementation recognizes a due queue head by comparing monotonic now with the base plus relative queue delay.
The logical absolute deadline is represented by the delta queue, not by one standalone absolute-deadline field.
The discharge AP is restricted to ACK and RST switch arms; other queue removals are not this proposition.
Both queue-removal branches require equality between the incoming MID and the queued generation's ID.
The queue matcher first requires the same session identity, which carries the endpoint scope for this frozen implementation.
The proposition is emitted only for an actual correlated removal, not merely because an ACK/RST entered coap_dispatch.

must_influencers.entity: coap_cancel_session_messages session argument and queued node.session
must_influencers.justification: Session cancellation removes exactly queue nodes whose stored session identity matches the API argument.

must_influencers.entity: context.sendqueue membership and removed coap_queue_t generation
must_influencers.justification: A local cancellation AP is generation-specific and requires that the node was present and then unlinked/deleted.

may_influencers.justification: The external API value reaches ack_timeout when its validation guard passes; otherwise the creation-time default or an earlier accepted value reaches the calculation.
The external API value conditionally replaces the default randomized factor.
At 94bacc89 a non-empty ACK and the OSCORE pre-decrypt path can require token equality; empty ACK and RST pass a null token and match by session+MID.

may_influencers.entity: coap_cancel_all_messages token argument and queued PDU actual_token
may_influencers.justification: A non-null token narrows cancellation; a null token cancels every queued node for the session.
Either a registered application callback or the build-selected default entropy source produces the byte consumed by the bound.

may_influencers.entity: outbound application API parameters and PDU setters
may_influencers.justification: Application-provided type/MID/session state can reach the trigger guards and exchange scope through several public API construction paths.
A valid UDP datagram supplies the ACK/RST type, MID, code and token fields, but malformed or nonmatching packets do not realize the proposition.

may_influencers.entity: transport l_write result and socket/session state
may_influencers.justification: The external write outcome and delay guards determine which coap_send_pdu return class reaches the trigger path.

scope_only_influencers.justification: Endpoint values partition exchanges. The queue matcher uses session identity, while the monitor retains explicit local/remote endpoint fields.
The allocation instance distinguishes a retransmission of one exchange from MID reuse by a later generation.

model_required_relationships.entity: queue insertion to later scheduler poll
model_required_relationships.justification: The node persists across event-loop iterations; an intra-invocation def-use slice cannot connect the commit to the later due check.

model_required_relationships.entity: logical deadline crossing independent of callback dispatch
model_required_relationships.justification: The AP denotes the scheduled logical crossing. If the event loop runs late, the callback time is diagnostic only and must not replace the stored-deadline semantics.
The generic analyzer can see the parse value flow, but needs a reusable parser-boundary declaration to classify raw datagram bytes as externally controllable.

model_required_relationships.entity: registered PRNG callback or operating-system entropy
model_required_relationships.justification: The indirect callback and system entropy source cross a reusable external-return boundary.

model_required_relationships.entity: queue-node generation through insert, reorder, remove and free
model_required_relationships.justification: Object identity must survive delta-queue reordering and removal without merging reused storage into the prior generation.

candidate_negative_controls.justification: The initial delay expression does not read max_retransmit; it affects later retry exhaustion and derived multi-retry envelopes. Human arbitration is still required before using this as a precision label.
Default leisure is the multicast-response delay parameter and is absent from the initial CON ACK timeout expression.
